Commentary.Commentary: Hats off to Bangladesh. Salma Khatun and Ritu Moni ran through the batting, sharing 7 wickets between them and they will be very happy that they are chasing down 92. Whether it is only 92 or not, only time will tell. Stay tuned.

Don't know how this all came about. The White Ferns got off to a terrific start, getting 36 for the first wicket and then a partnership for the third wicket between Suzie Bates and Maddy Green. But the former's wicket triggered a collapse and the White Ferns had no answer to the spinning ball. Off spin leg spin, no spin, flipper, you name it. The questions were asked but there were no answers.

That is a complete shocker. From 66/2 to 91 all out. 8 wickets for 25 runs! New Zealand had this issue coming into the World Cup that their middle order has not had batting time in the middle at all. And today, those fears have compounded really badly.

OUT! LBW! The decision is reversed and NEW ZEALAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 91! The ball is landed outside off, Tahuhu looks to flick it across the line but misses as the ball spins in. Beats the bat and hits the pads and up goes Salma in an appeal. But the umpire moves away. The captain cum bowler instantly goes for the review and Ultra Edge does not detect any spike. Ball Tracker shows three reds, with the ball projected to hit the leg stump!
Huge shout for LBW! Turned down and the skipper immediately asks for the review. And Ball Tracker shows why - Three reds and New Zealand are all out!

MIX UP, BUT SAFE! Outside off, Mair punches it towards point. There is a mix up between the two batters and there is a run out chance at the keeper's end but the throw is late and weak to the keeper. Tahuhu makes it.
Salma Khatun comes back on. 2-0-6-2 so far.
Loop and outside off, Tahuhu looks to push but the ball spins away past the outside edge.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Rosemary Mair is the last batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Excellent keeping, beautiful bowling. Honest batting too, not waiting for the umpire to give his verdict. Beautifully looped up outside off, Kasperek initially comes forward but then goes back and looks to push. She is not sure whether the ball will spin in or go away. The ball spins away, takes the outside edge and settles into the mitts of the keeper. There is an appeal made and the finger is raised but the batter walks.
Full and around off, Tahuhu leans and swings it down to long on for a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Full and outside off, Tahuhu looks to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge and goes past short third man, who circles all around the ball. Misses it. But just a run taken.
Punches this towards short third man for a single.
Lea Tahuhu walks in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Another one caught at point. Short and outside off, Kerr looks to cut but finds point. Fahima Khatun takes a sitter.

DROPPED! Tough chance, great attempt. Landed outside off, Kerr looks to drive but the ball goes away, takes the outside edge and goes to short third man. Or slightly wide, rather. Salma Khatun dives to her left but the ball goes off her hands towards the fence. Two runs taken.
On middle, pushed to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Leigh Kasperek walks in at number 9, replacing Peterson.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a stunner from Fargana Hogue. Full and outside off, Peterson gets down and aims a mighty slog. But all she manages is a top edge. The ball seems like it will not carry to deep mid-wicket but Fargana comes running in from the fence, keeps her eyes on the ball and then dives forward to take a brilliant catch! They are into the tail now.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, punched wide of cover for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful batting. Full and outside off, Peterson jumps down the track and lofts it with finesse over mid off for a boundary.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Peterson looks to play that, then wants to leave it. Is late and gets beaten.
Landed outside off, played through point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Anna Peterson walks in at number 8, replacing Martin.

OUT! CAUGHT! Cut straight to point. Wicket number 6 goes. Are we onto something here? Short and wide outside off, Martin rocks back and looks to cut. She cannot keep it down and finds Fahima Khatun at point!
FOUR! Dragged away. A boundary after 31 balls. Full and outside off, Martin gets across, looks to sweep but the ball goes off the inner half and beats short fine leg!
Outside off, Martin looks to punch this down the ground but mistimes it off the bottom edge towards the bowler who leaps and fumbles. Mid off mops it up.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover. Could this be a game-changing over?
Flicks this off her pads for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Amelia Kerr walks in next.

OUT! DROPPED, BUT A RUN OUT! Trouble, trouble for New Zealand. Full and outside off, Martin chips it straight back to the bowler. It is low and Rumana tries to get her hand to it but cannot hold on. However, the ball drops down and trickles onto the stumps! Rumana first appeals and then celebrates as the umpire refers it upstairs. Jensen is already walking and replays show why - she is nowhere in the picture when the ball hits the stumps!
Is that a run out first ball? Jensen is already walking back! Referred upstairs... Hayley is gone!
Katey Martin walks in at number 6, replacing Green.

OUT! STUMPED! Nicely done by the bowler. Floated outside off, Green comes down the track but is deceived by the flight and lack of pace. She tries to manufacture a swing but misses. The ball dips and then spins away, to beat the outside edge. She is far too down the track and the keeper Nigar Sultana whips off the bails!
Full and outside off, swept-hit down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, punched past point for a single.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Hayley Jensen walks in at number 5, replacing Bates.

OUT! BOWLED! That has gone right through! A ripper of a delivery from Moni. A length ball, outside off, Bates goes back and looks to flick against the line but misses. The ball stays low, skids through and hits the middle stump! Ritu is pumped and jumping up and down in joy.
Around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Comes down the track and drives this to long on for another single.
Full and around off, eased through mid on for one more.
Full on middle, eased down to long on for one more.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Comes down the track and eases it down to long off for a single.
Rumana Ahmed into the attack.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for one more.
Full and outside off, Bates looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. Lands short of point.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Goes off the back foot and punches the ball.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Ritu Moni into the attack now.
Yorker outside off, dug out back to the bowler.
Punches this off the back foot for one more.
Comes down the track and eases it down the ground for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Full and outside off on the Free Hit, Suzie swings it over mid-wicket and finds the fence again!
FOUR! Short and outside off, Bates rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary! It is a NO BALL as well for height.
Punches this off the back foot for a single.
Short and outside off, punched towards mid on for one more.
Short and outside off, punched wide of cover for a run.
Punches this off the back foot.
Comes down the track and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to the bowler.
Maddy Green comes in at number 4, replacing Priest.

OUT! LBW! Well, it was a surprise that it was reviewed in the first place. It comes even as a bigger surprise that the review is not lost, with the event looking dead plumb. Full and outside off, Priest got down to sweep but missed and was hit on the pads. There was an appeal and up went the umpire's finger. Priest looks up at Bates and then signals the 'T'. Ball Tracker shows the impact to be around off, indicating umpire's call but the ball to be hitting the leg stump.
Priest has been adjudged LBW! She asks her captain and then signals for the review. Here comes Ball Tracker. Impact is umpire's call while the ball is projected to spin into the leg stump!
Excellent yorker, on middle, dug out past the bowler towards mid on for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, Priest looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads. The ball goes back to the bowler.
WIDE. Slashes hard but misses.
Outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Outside off, Priest slashes hard but misses. There is an appeal for a catch but it is turned down.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Suzie Bates walks in at number 3, replacing Devine.
OUT! CAUGHT! The first breakthrough has come. Short and outside off, Devine goes back, looks to cut but cannot keep it down. It is straight to Fahima Khatun who takes it and leaps in joy!
Works this straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for one more.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Salma Khatun into the attack now.
FOUR! Fine way to end the Powerplay. Short and outside off, Devine gets across and then pulls it over mid on. Finds the fence. 33/0 in the Powerplay.
Full and outside off, Priest looks to sweep but misses. The ball goes off her pads towards short third man. There is an appeal for LBW but the impact was well outside off. A leg bye taken.
Short and outside off, RP looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. It flies in the air but does not carry to point.
Short and outside off, spinning away, Rachel looks to cut but is beaten by the lack of pace.
FOUR! Not cleanly hit but it is a boundary. Full and outside off, Priest comes down the track and swings it over mid on. It clears the fielder and rolls into the fence.
Full and outside off, swung down to long on for a single.
FOUR! THWACK! Full and outside off, Priest swings it over mid-wicket and finds the fence!
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
FOUR! That breaks the shackles. Full and outside off, Priest swings it wide of a diving mid on, to her right, to the fence.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, cut towards backward point. There is a misfield and Devine wants the single but is sent back as the fielder recovers quickly.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Punches this off the back foot.
Landed outside off, Rachel looks to guide but the ball takes the outside edge and flies wide of short third man. Two runs taken.
Full and wide outside off, stays low, Priest looks to punch but misses.
Landed outside off, punched straight to cover.
Oohhh... a return catch. Not taken. Full and outside off, Devine comes down the track and hammers it straight back. Khatun leaps but the ball goes through. A single to long off.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and around off, swept straight to short fine leg.
Works this down the leg side for a couple.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Landed outside off, Priest looks to cut but is cramped for room. The ball cuts back in and beats the inside edge. Just about misses the stumps as well.
Landed outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
Full and outside off, swept through mid-wicket for one more.
Punches this off the cover for a single.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Works this through mid-wicket for a run.
DROPPED? Seems to be so. Outside off, short in length, Priest looks to cut but is cramped for room. The keeper fumbles. However, Ultra Edge does not detect any spike.
Short and outside off, slapped through the covers for a single.
Fahima Khatun to bowl from the other end.
Short and wide outside off, punched straight to point. An ordinary start by Ghosh.
Full and wide outside off again, Priest looks to go after this one but miscues it over cover. Gets a couple.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to cover-point.
Another drive through the covers, gets one more added to the total.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to short extra cover. A misfield allows a single.
The players are out in the middle. Sophie Devine and Rachel Priest are the openers for New Zealand. Panna Ghosh will start off proceedings. Devine to face. Here we go...

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Ayasha Rahman, Murshida Khatun, Ritu Moni, Nigar Sultana(WK), Fargana Hoque, Rumana Ahmed, Sobhana Mostary, Salma Khatun(C), Fahima Khatun, Jahanara Alam and Panna Ghosh.
New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Rachel Priest(WK), Sophie Devine(C), Suzie Bates, Maddy Green, Katey Martin, Amelia Kerr, Hayley Jensen, Anna Peterson, Leigh Kasperek, Lea Tahuhu and Rosemary Mair.
PITCH REPORT - The track has a bit of grass on it but the colours are different. That means there will be indifferent bounce.

Bangladesh captain, Salma Khatun, says that the wicket is good and if the bowlers stick to good lines and lengths, they can do well. She is very excited on Bangladesh meeting New Zealand and hopes that her team does well. Informs that there are 4 changes in the playing XI.

New Zealand skipper, Sophie Devine, says that she wants to bat first today as they have chased in both of their previous games. Does not want to look too much into last game's loss and instead, takes the way it was finished, bringing the game close, as a positive. Is not looking too far ahead into the potential quarter-final with Australia. Wants to finish this game first, win it and then move ahead.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. Sophie Devine flips it, Heads is the call from Salma Khatun but it is a Tail. NEW ZEALAND WILL BAT FIRST.
WEATHER - Overcast skies started the day, but now, the conditions are bright and sunny.

Game 13 is here! Bangladesh take on New Zealand in their first ever clash in Women's T20Is. Coming to the context of the game, for the world, this is a dead rubber, except for the fact that if New Zealand lose, they need to lose by a small margin. But if truth be told, Bangladesh are not totally out yet. Can we get a good contest? Hello and a warm welcome to the Saturday double header of the 2020 T20 World Cup at the Junction Oval, Melbourne. The India-Sri Lanka game is right after this.
